subject.title: fix(qqbot): surface terminal reply-session conflict failures

question: Should QQBot land this narrow local classifier and terminal notice now, with migration to the shared SDK classifier deferred until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109902 has an approved plugin-API contract?
rationale: The user-visible QQBot repair is independent, but the permanent ownership and stability of reply-session conflict classification crosses the channel and Plugin SDK boundary.

options.title: Land local notice, migrate later
options.body: Accept the bounded QQBot-local classifier now to stop silent failures, then migrate it when an approved shared SDK classifier lands.

options.title: Sequence behind the SDK classifier
options.body: Pause this PR until the Plugin SDK classifier contract is approved and have QQBot consume that contract in the same or a follow-up change.

options.title: Keep logging-only behavior
options.body: Decline the terminal notice and retain current silent delivery failure behavior while broader recovery design is decided.

recommendation.title: Land local notice, migrate later
recommendation.body: Accept the bounded QQBot-local classifier now to stop silent failures, then migrate it when an approved shared SDK classifier lands.

likelyOwner.reason: The shared retry implementation establishes the error boundary whose terminal handling and classifier ownership need sequencing.
